// rt_priv_umode.S
//
// L6 fixture: the ROI runs in U-mode. Same shape as rt_priv_smode.S
// (see there for the why of each step); only the mret target privilege
// differs -- MPP stays U (00) -- and the harness expects CHECK_PRIV=0.

#include "semihost_exit.inc"

.section .text
.globl _start
_start:
    li      t0, -1
    csrw    pmpaddr0, t0            // NAPOT over the full address space
    li      t0, 0x1F                // A=NAPOT | X | W | R
    csrw    pmpcfg0, t0

    la      t0, trap_exit
    csrw    mtvec, t0

    li      t0, (3 << 11)
    csrc    mstatus, t0             // MPP <- U (00)
    la      t0, roi
    csrw    mepc, t0
    mret                            // drop to U-mode

roi:
    slti    x0, x0, 0x5A0           // ENTER: QEMU1 drains, priv must be 0

    li      t1, 0x7000
    li      t2, 53
    mul     t3, t1, t2              // U-mode work; lands in the drained GPRs

    slti    x0, x0, 0x5A1           // EXIT: vsim drains, priv must be 0
    .rept 16                        // halt slack pad: the DMI halt lands a
    nop                             // core-dependent few insns past the
    .endr                           // trigger; keep the privilege-changing
                                    // ecall out of the halt's reach
    ecall                           // U -> M (medeleg=0): trap_exit

.align 2
trap_exit:
    li      a2, 0
    SEMIHOST_EXIT a2
